moves.name: Butt
moves.notes: Always followed by Butt. Always used at the start of combat. If Nibbit appears alone, it starts with this move. In the normal loop, this also follows "Hiss".

moves.name: Butt
moves.notes: Always followed by Hiss. Always used at the start of combat. If Nibbit is not alone and is in front, it starts with this move. It is always followed by "Hiss".

moves.name: Hiss
moves.notes: Always followed by Butt. Always used at the start of combat. If Nibbit is not alone and is not in front, it starts with this move. It is always followed by "Butt".
